\section[(dialogue)]{Wanting, liking and having — a first pass}

\label{lesson:MW-R119-first-pass-wanting-liking-and-having}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a bucket and a broom.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to share out, to mislay, to reach, to fly, to weigh
  \item to want, a wish, the mind, hope, a demand
  \item a need, greed, a dream, an expectation, one's will
  \item to seem, a liking, a hobby, affection, attachment
  \item to be able to, a skill, strength, courage, an owner
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To share out? (\textbf{\mw{बांटणो}}, \emph{bā̃ṭṇo}.) To mislay? (\textbf{\mw{गमावणो}}, \emph{gamāvṇo}.) To reach? (\textbf{\mw{पूगणो}}, \emph{pūgṇo}.) To fly? (\textbf{\mw{उडणो}}, \emph{uṛṇo}.) To weigh? (\textbf{\mw{तोलणो}}, \emph{tolṇo}.) To want? (\textbf{\mw{चावणो}}, \emph{chāvṇo}.) A wish? (\textbf{\mw{इच्छा}}, \emph{ichchhā}.) The mind? (\textbf{\mw{मन}}, \emph{man}.) Hope? (\textbf{\mw{आस}}, \emph{ās}.) A demand? (\textbf{\mw{मांग}}, \emph{mā̃g}.) A need? (\textbf{\mw{जरूरत}}, \emph{jarūrat}.) Greed? (\textbf{\mw{लालच}}, \emph{lālach}.) A dream? (\textbf{\mw{सपनो}}, \emph{sapno}.) An expectation? (\textbf{\mw{उम्मीद}}, \emph{ummīd}.) One's will? (\textbf{\mw{मरजी}}, \emph{marjī}.) To seem? (\textbf{\mw{लागणो}}, \emph{lāgṇo}.) A liking? (\textbf{\mw{पसंद}}, \emph{pasand}.) A hobby? (\textbf{\mw{सौक}}, \emph{sauk}.) Affection? (\textbf{\mw{हेत}}, \emph{het}.) Attachment? (\textbf{\mw{मोह}}, \emph{moh}.) To be able to? (\textbf{\mw{सकणो}}, \emph{sakṇo}.) A skill? (\textbf{\mw{हुनर}}, \emph{hunar}.) Strength? (\textbf{\mw{ताकत}}, \emph{tākat}.) Courage? (\textbf{\mw{हिम्मत}}, \emph{himmat}.) An owner? (\textbf{\mw{मालक}}, \emph{mālak}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Why, and the kitchen — a second pass}

\label{lesson:MW-R119-second-pass-why-and-the-kitchen}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for land and property.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item land, property, capital, earnings, a job
  \item a virtue, good sense, knowledge, a right, a chance
  \item why, a reason, for, because of, because
  \item a hearth, a griddle, a wok, a cooking pot, a water pot
  \item a large clay pot, a small water vessel, a glass, a bucket, a broom
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Land? (\textbf{\mw{जमीन}}, \emph{jamīn}.) Property? (\textbf{\mw{जायदाद}}, \emph{jāydād}.) Capital? (\textbf{\mw{पूंजी}}, \emph{pū̃jī}.) Earnings? (\textbf{\mw{कमाई}}, \emph{kamāī}.) A job? (\textbf{\mw{नौकरी}}, \emph{naukrī}.) A virtue? (\textbf{\mw{गुण}}, \emph{guṇ}.) Good sense? (\textbf{\mw{अकल}}, \emph{akal}.) Knowledge? (\textbf{\mw{ग्यान}}, \emph{gyān}.) A right? (\textbf{\mw{हक}}, \emph{hak}.) A chance? (\textbf{\mw{मौको}}, \emph{mauko}.) Why? (\textbf{\mw{क्यूं}}, \emph{kyū̃}.) A reason? (\textbf{\mw{कारण}}, \emph{kāraṇ}.) For? (\textbf{\mw{वास्तै}}, \emph{vāstai}.) Because of? (\textbf{\mw{खातर}}, \emph{khātar}.) Because? (\textbf{\mw{क्यूंकै}}, \emph{kyū̃kai}.) A hearth? (\textbf{\mw{चूल्हो}}, \emph{chūlho}.) A griddle? (\textbf{\mw{तवो}}, \emph{tavo}.) A wok? (\textbf{\mw{कड़ाही}}, \emph{kaṛāhī}.) A cooking pot? (\textbf{\mw{हांडी}}, \emph{hā̃ḍī}.) A water pot? (\textbf{\mw{घड़ो}}, \emph{ghaṛo}.) A large clay pot? (\textbf{\mw{मटको}}, \emph{maṭko}.) A small water vessel? (\textbf{\mw{लोटो}}, \emph{loṭo}.) A glass? (\textbf{\mw{गिलास}}, \emph{gilās}.) A bucket? (\textbf{\mw{बाल्टी}}, \emph{bālṭī}.) A broom? (\textbf{\mw{बुहारी}}, \emph{buhārī}.)
